senses.gloss: pr. n. pl.K’far Sisay, a gentile place in Palestine, belonging to the district of Acco, although near Sepphoris.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 6b:3">Gitt. 6ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Gittin 1:3">Tosef. ib. I, 3</cite> <cite ref="O00021"><he>סָאסַאי</he></cite> (Var. <he>סָסַי</he>); Y. ib. I, 43ᶜ top <cite ref="O01089"><he>סמיי</he></cite> (corr. acc.).
